about: M09 review stills and checks (brief 7.3 M09 and the M09 review). Each group is one capture.mjs run on m09-settings-handheld.html: node mockups/tools/capture.mjs m09-settings-handheld.html <devices> <outDir> --states "<name>:<query>;..." built from the group's states, with --full when the group says so. Keys starting with @ are capture actions (README, Capture). A --full capture holds all seven stages, one 1920 x 1080 Ally screen each (with clean=1 a stage is one viewport tall), so it can be cut per stage. A viewport capture shows stage 1 (CONTROLS), the frame the pad presses act on; each press state waits 400 ms at the end so the focus-out fade has finished before the still.
checks: Rows are 48 canvas px (96 px on the capture).
Smallest text on the 1920 x 1080 capture is 18 px or more.
One highlight per frame after every D-pad press; no ring while the input is touch.
LB and RB change the tab and its rows together.
No keyboard or mouse glyph while the input is pad.
Every label sits on one line.
After 8 D-pad presses the focused row is inside the visible body (needs wo.js follow-focus).
Every FRAME LIMIT choice shows whole, clear of the fade (needs the shared list layer).
The five tabs fit the strip at TEXT SIZE 125% (needs the shared handheld tab size).
